## Summary
Describe the documentation, checklist, or defensive code change.

## Safety and quality checklist
- [ ] Any tested asset is owned by me or explicitly authorized in writing.
- [ ] Scope and program rules were checked before testing.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, cookies, personal data, or private evidence are included.
- [ ] Evidence uses synthetic data and is minimized/redacted.
- [ ] No destructive, disruptive, or out-of-scope testing is described.
- [ ] Findings include impact, reproducible safe steps, and remediation.
- [ ] Claims are evidence-based and distinguish confirmed facts from hypotheses.
